title: Control path expansion before it controls latency
description: Choose a workload, then change anchor cardinality, typed relationship degree, depth, and expansion-time pruning. The model updates the query frontier and operational warning together.

workloads.label: Fraud ring investigation
workloads.detail: Follow recent transfers from one constrained account identity.
workloads.guidance: Filter transfer time, status, and direction while expanding; cap depth to the investigation question and review high-volume hub accounts separately.

workloads.label: Product recommendation
workloads.detail: Move from one customer through purchases to candidate products.
workloads.guidance: Limit the interaction window, exclude already-owned products during expansion, aggregate early, and return a bounded candidate set to the ranker.

workloads.label: Service dependency impact
workloads.detail: Trace downstream services from one failing component.
workloads.guidance: Keep environment and active-version predicates inside the traversal so retired edges do not inflate the blast-radius calculation.
